E1315

Hangar ingest, executable lease handoff, or digest verification failed

What

Hangar ingest, executable lease handoff, or digest verification failed

Why

Race-safe no-follow ingest re-stats open handles and aborts if the source mutates; the authenticated executable lease protocol rejects invalid keys, frames, owner locks, snapshots, and receipts before a child starts; verify re-hashes and compares the envelope digest; independent producer disagreement remains in `private/unreproducible/<action-key>.json` and cannot satisfy trusted cache policy.

Fix

Re-run realization or ingest against a stable tree; if the error names executable lease state, repair the lease service state and retry without deleting the last good Hangar object; inspect the structured reproducibility report and fix the nondeterminism.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1315: tests/ui/hangar_verify_digest_mismatch.stderr.

Error [E1315]: hangar ingest rejected: hardlink `payload` has 2 link(s), but only 1 are inside the output
 Why: hangar ingest rejected: hardlink `payload` has 2 link(s), but only 1 are inside the output
 Fix: fix the rejected tree (path law, special files, or unsupported xattrs) and ingest again.
